text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I was walking around the 
summer training camp—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Zousan... I mean, good 
morning.
choice_data_list: Are you feeling tired?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yesterday, I visited the racetrack for my 
next scheduled run. I ran through various 
trials combining the opponents' data and 
weather conditions, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Every time I do it, I see all kinds of new 
patterns. I kept cycling through the PDCA 
loop, and before I knew it, it got late.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leaving nothing to chance. It's typical of 
her, sure— but perhaps she's putting a bit 
too much pressure on herself.
choice_data_list:
...Hey, Crown. Want to go out this 
weekend?
……Hey, Crown. Wanna go out this weekend?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: An outing? ...Isn't this rather sudden?
choice_data_list:
There's somewhere I absolutely have to go 
with you.

There's somewhere I absolutely have to go 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ? ...If you insist that much—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, isn't this a Hong Kong cuisine 
restaurant! To be honest, I've been 
curious about this place too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Is this the place you wanted to come 
to?
choice_data_list:
I saw it online and it's been on my 
mind...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Half truth, half lie. I also knew she had 
caught his eye for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I wanted to bring you here. I 
thought it might help take your mind off 
racing, even just a little."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't we sort out race details 
a bit before the shopkeeper arrives?
choice_data_list: Huh! A-About the race!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I mean, look, the shop staff looked so 
busy! I thought I'd at least help organize 
the basics... but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Oh? Is that food being brought to our 
table...? We haven't ordered yet, have we?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"This speediness... Did you ask for this 
in advance by any chance?"
choice_data_list:
Yeah, I learned how to prepare properly 
from watching you.

Yeah, because I learned how to prepare by 
watching you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, Trainer, really. Besides, didn't you 
make a great choice?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Siu mei rice... and roast goose... and 
shrimp wontons too—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Nothing but things I love—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
......Dohjeh, Trainer! It'd be a waste if 
it gets cold, so let's dig in!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That was delicious♪ Now then, shall we 
head back to the training camp lodge?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She's just started showing brighter smiles 
more often. There's no way it's going to 
end here.
choice_data_list: Won't you stay with me a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Playing chess while looking at the sea... 
Fufu, you certainly know wonderful spots!
choice_data_list: Crown, let's settle this in a single match

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Flawless moves, through and through. Were 
you always this good at chess?
choice_data_list: Yeah. I practiced a little bit.
Yeah. I practiced a little.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Hmm. So you wanted to show me the 
result?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There is no mistake. I practiced chess a 
lot. Because—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to become someone she could 
compete with seriously. Someone who could 
genuinely entertain her in the truest 
sense.
choice_data_list: —Check.
—Check it out.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
…………Wow, when did that happen? Looks like 
I'll have to get serious too♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~! The day just flew by, didn't it?♪ My 
body feels so light, too!
choice_data_list: I'm glad if you enjoyed it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for escorting me today. The 
dinner and the chess match were both so 
much fun!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you. Truly.
choice_data_list: What's the matter?
What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No... It just made me feel like giving it 
my all. ...For your sake, too.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly. To escort me to such an 
extent—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's my Trainer for you♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"I won't brush your feelings aside. So, 
let's keep things smart from here on out♪"
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's go for a smart victory!
Yeah! Let's go for a smart victory!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...By the way, Trainer. Would you 
like to hang out with me again on our next 
day off?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"To return the favor for today, I'll make 
sure to be your escort next time♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, a few days later...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This place has a great view and a huge 
menu. The food is super delicious, too♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment I reached for the menu, dish 
after dish began to be placed in front of 
me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I placed the order ahead of time. 
Taking a leaf out of your book♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I tried to order everything according to 
your tastes... My research wasn't off, was 
it?
choice_data_list: Crown...! Ah, perfect!
Crown...! Yeah, it's perfect!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, wonderful♪ Well then, shall we make 
a toast?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—Let's have a rematch♪ I can't just take 
that lying down!
choice_data_list: What a confident girl...
What a bold girl...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"You've known that for a long time now, 
haven't you? Well, are you ready?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, a serious Satono Crown thoroughly 
crushed the opposition.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
How do you like this private beach? We've 
got it all to ourselves today♪
choice_data_list:
Such a huge beach... and we have it all to 
ourselves.

Such a huge beach... and we have it all to 
ourselves, huh?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
This place is super famous! To be honest, 
it was a fierce battle to get 
reservations, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to return everything I received 
from you twofold... so I gave it my all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In everything, mutual trust is what 
matters most, right?♪ You'll accept my 
return gift, won't you?
